CloudTalk integrates seamlessly with **C** RMs, help desks, sales platforms, and automation tools, enabling businesses to sync data, streamline communication, and automate workflows. This guide walks you through the setup, key functionalities, and data synchronization across various integrations.

## [​](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/10570091-integrations-guide\#h_f11f59e53d)  Setting Up Your Integrations

Before using an integration, it must be properly configured. CloudTalk offers direct integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Pipedrive, Zoho, and more, making setup quick and easy.Start by configuring your integrations with these step-by-step guides **:**

- **CRM & Sales Integrations** – [Salesforce](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/3368501-configure-salesforce), [HubSpot](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/3206271-configure-hubspot), [Pipedrive](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/2843578-configure-pipedrive), [Zoho](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/3490662-configure-zoho), [Copper](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/5639577-configure-copper), Outreach, [Salesloft](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/5890178-configure-salesloft), [ActiveCampaign](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/5639069-configure-activecampaign), [Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/7052011-configure-microsoft-dynamics-365-sales), [Capsule CRM](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/11169594-configure-capsule-crm), [noCRM](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/11485402-configure-nocrm), [monday.com](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/11599003-configure-monday-com), [Odoo](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/11703488-configure-odoo), [Close](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/13004211-configure-close), and [Freshsales (Freshworks CRM)](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/14595190-configure-freshsales-freshworks-crm).
- **Help Desk & Support Integrations** – [Zendesk](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/3402805-configure-zendesk), [Zendesk Sell](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/3722182-configure-zendesk-sell), [Freshdesk](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/2582636-configure-freshdesk), [Intercom](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/2583571-configure-intercom), [Help Scout](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/2271916-configure-help-scout), [Gorgias](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/4393482-configure-gorgias), [Kustomer](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/6604201-configure-kustomer), [LiveAgent](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/3895756-configure-liveagent), [Front](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/3548863-configure-front), and [Zoho Desk](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/6114608-configure-zoho-desk).
- **E-commerce & Productivity Integrations** – [Adobe Commerce (Magento)](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/5775029-configure-adobe-commerce-magento), [Shopify](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/11722533-configure-shopify), [Make](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/5641761-configure-make), [Playvox](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/6382667-configure-playvox), and [Gong](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/5353533-configure-gong).
- **Recruitment Integrations** – [Workable](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/11791405-configure-workable), [Greenhouse](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/11937842-configure-greenhouse), and [Bullhorn](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/13924700-configure-bullhorn).
- **Collaboration & Communication** – [Microsoft Teams](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/14410073-configure-ms-teams).
- **Workflow Automation** – [Zapier](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/3410740-configure-zapier) and CloudTalk’s internal automation features.

## [​](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/10570091-integrations-guide\#h_9f040fe23e)  Automating Call Workflows & Data Exports

CloudTalk integrations allow you to **automate repetitive tasks, sync call logs, and trigger workflows across platforms**.Automation features include **:**

- **Speech-to-Text Exports** – Send call transcriptions directly to [HubSpot](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/8386173-export-speech-to-text-to-hubspot).
- **Power Dialer Campaigns** – Use saved [Salesforce](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/9170735-salesforce-contact-lists-in-campaigns) and [HubSpot](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/9562215-using-hubspot-with-campaign-dialers) contact lists to automate outbound campaigns.
- **Automatic SMS Actions** – Set up SMS triggers in [HubSpot Workflows](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/6118552-hubspot-sms-workflows), [Pipedrive Automation](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/14594584-send-cloudtalk-sms-from-pipedrive-via-automation), and [CloudTalk Automations](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/8249875-how-to-send-an-automatic-sms-using-call-flow-designer).
- **Salesforce Cadences** – Connect CloudTalk with the [Salesforce Engagement platform](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/8494589-salesforce-cadences) for structured outreach sequences.

## [​](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/10570091-integrations-guide\#h_645905b308)  Managing Contact Merging & Data Sync

Keeping your customer records organized is crucial when working with multiple tools. CloudTalk helps merge and sync data effortlessly.

### [​](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/10570091-integrations-guide\#h_326a943940)  Contact & Call Data Synchronization

- **[HubSpot](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/3206271-configure-hubspot) and [Copper](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/5639691-copper-data-sync) Data Sync** – Ensure up-to-date customer records across platforms.
- **[Automatic Contact Merging](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/5639498-contact-merging)** – Prevent duplicates and consolidate data automatically.
- **[How CloudTalk Syncs Data with Your CRM](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/14665732-how-cloudtalk-syncs-data-with-your-crm)** – Understand sync frequency, contact import timing, and call export behavior across all integrations.
- **[Re-authorizing Your CRM Integration](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/14817211-re-authorizing-your-crm-integration)** – Refresh or replace credentials without disabling your integration or triggering a full re-sync.

### [​](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/10570091-integrations-guide\#h_18bf640d83)  Salesforce & HubSpot-Specific Features

- **Salesforce [Actions](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/9394264-salesforce-actions), [Field Mapping](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/9620351-salesforce-field-mapping) & [Einstein Conversation Insights](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/8290842-einstein-conversation-insights-setup)** – Automate call exports, track data using Salesforce fields, and surface AI-powered conversation insights.
- **[HubSpot Quick Fixes](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/8272721-hubspot-quick-fixes)** – Troubleshoot common issues when syncing data.
- **[Zendesk Custom Field Mapping](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/14300299-configure-custom-field-mapping-for-zendesk)** – Sync CloudTalk call data to Zendesk ticket fields for structured tracking and reporting.

## [​](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/10570091-integrations-guide\#h_f20cf9282a)  Expanding Communication with WhatsApp & Messaging

Beyond voice calls, CloudTalk integrates with **WhatsApp and SMS platforms** to extend your communication channels.

- **[How to Activate CloudTalk’s WhatsApp Integration](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/7033929-how-to-activate-a-whatsapp-integration-number)** – Set up WhatsApp Business messaging.
- **[How to Use WhatsApp with CloudTalk](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/6811232-how-to-use-whatsapp-with-cloudtalk)** – Engage customers via WhatsApp-approved templates.
- **[HubSpot SMS Workflows](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/6118552-hubspot-sms-workflows)** – Automate SMS messaging in HubSpot.

## [​](https://help.cloudtalk.io/en/articles/10570091-integrations-guide\#h_a3b8c9d1e2)  Using CloudTalk with Your Integrations
